style_when: the story turns on one physical thing — a part, a material, a component, a document — and what that thing costs, contains or crosses a border is the news
prompt: Editorial macro photograph, 100mm macro lens, razor-sharp focal plane, shallow depth of field. An asymmetric off-centre layout with the hero subject positioned on the right third. Extreme close-up of a heavy textured rag paper audit ledger bearing a delicate, formal blind-embossed governance seal, violently over-stamped with a stark, heavy red ink expiration mark that bleeds into the raw paper fibers. Soft directional daylight throws deep micro-shadows across the tactile paper grain, highlighting the tension between the permanent embossing and the aggressive temporary stamp. Muted warm tones, sophisticated editorial cover standard.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, watermarks, UI, people, blurry, abstract geometry
rationale: Editorial macro perfectly captures the fragility of the audit trail by focusing tightly on a physical record, emphasizing the sudden invalidation (expiration stamp) over the permanent governance proof (embossing).
